space: Cosine per (observation, seed) over the (64, 7) action chunk in normalized action space (dataset_stats.json min/max to [-1, 1]); MAE against ground truth in real action units over the valid ground-truth rows. References: official ImageWAM bf16 and FlashRT fp16, both stored in the fixture, same initial noise.

fp16.note: H100 end-to-end baseline for fp16 vs official: median 0.99840, min 0.99567, mean MAE 0.18359 (issues.md ISSUE-002). The fp16 reference is generated on H100; on another device this check measures cross-device drift of the same math.

nvfp4.note: Provisional until the first Thor gate run. Thor evidence: nvfp4 vs fp16 action cosine 0.9998 on one real frame, open-loop MAE 1.01x fp16 over 50 frames (opportunities.md OPT-014).

fp8_static.note: Gated only with a real activation-calibration file (IMAGEWAM_FP8_CALIBRATION or --fp8-calibration). With the N(0, 0.1) placeholder calibration, fp8_static reached backbone_hidden cosine ~0.46 on Thor (opportunities.md OPT-014), so it is never gated without one. Same bounds as nvfp4, the precision it would replace.
